name: Brass Dragon’s Sand Moving
body:
You gain the brass dragon’s ability to move sand.

Prerequisite(s): Draconic bloodline (must choose brass dragon), 1st-level dragon disciple

Benefit: Once per day as a standard action, you are able to magically move sand. This ability functions as move earth, but it only affects sand. Your caster level for this effect is equal to your arcane spellcaster level tied to the dragon disciple class.
